posts.text:
Billionaires have an executive team. Now you do too.

A Player Mode puts a five-person executive team in one app:
Executive Coach
Executive Assistant
Chief of Staff
Accountability Partner
Cognitive Behavioral Mindset Coach

You answer a few easy-tap questions. About 3 minutes later you have a working plan, and from then on your agenda is ready every morning: one priority, a short start, then the day.

It's built for founders, operators, parents and anyone carrying too much. Every project, promise and restart you keep in your head is load. Five roles carry it with you.

The first 100 members pay $9.99 a month, and it stays $9.99 for as long as they stay subscribed. It renews monthly until you cancel, and you can cancel any time in the app.

See how it works: https://aplayermode.com

#founders #productivity

You said Thursday. Your team remembered.

On Monday you tell ChatGPT you'll send the investor follow-up by Thursday. It writes a good draft. On Thursday it doesn't bring it up, and neither do you.

A chat gives good advice, one conversation at a time. A Player Mode works across days:
The Radar, the list in the app of what you said you'd do and when each is due, catches dropped promises, and with your Outlook inbox connected it flags who you owe a reply.
The plan you set this morning still stands at 2 p.m.
Miss a day and tomorrow is a minimum day, with no catch-up.

If your day has more inputs than hours, follow-through is what's missing.

There are two ways to get it. The app runs the five roles for you, from $9.99 a month for the first 100 members. Or Billionaire High Performance Coach OS installs the same five roles into the AI you already use, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, for $49 once on Gumroad, and you run it yourself.

Compare the two: https://aplayermode.com

#founders #chiefofstaff

A bad week shouldn't break the plan.

A Player Mode is built for the days that don't go to plan:
Never Miss Twice: one missed day doesn't turn into drift.
Minimum day: after a miss, the next day shrinks instead of piling up catch-up.
Recovery mode: one tap in a low season gives you a minimum day with no catch-up and no guilt.
Executive Review: when your head is full, it organizes the 3 to 7 things you already know.
High-Pressure mode: when you're stuck or avoiding something, it cuts through the noise and ends with one clear directive.

There are three plans, and each does all five jobs. Executive Roundtable is $24.99 a month: it plans and coaches, and you do the last step. The first 100 members pay $9.99 a month for as long as they stay subscribed. Executive Suite is $39.99 a month and Autopilot is $79.99 a month. The plans page shows what each one adds.

Monthly plans renew each month and annual plans each year, until you cancel. You can cancel any time in the app.

It works in any phone or computer browser today; the App Store and Google Play versions are coming soon.

https://aplayermode.com

#founders #productivity
